basic_info.description: Nestled in San Francisco's desirable Richmond district, this classic 1915 Edwardian home is a true gem. Spanning 2,010 square feet on a 2,495 square foot lot, the residence features 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, a formal dining room, a sunroom, and original period details with built-ins. With over 70 years of family history, it radiates historical charm. Located near Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach and convenient to public transit, dining, and shopping, the property offers both comfort and convenience. A garage with 1-car parking and a 1-bedroom, 1-bath in-law unit complete the home. It's an ideal canvas for personalization, blending classic charm with modern possibilities. Make this iconic San Francisco residence your own!
